=Act as a Senior Social Media Creative Director and AI Advertising Strategist.

Create a high-engagement content strategy for Aquafoundry for:
{{ $node["Code in JavaScript"].json["duration"] }} days.

The goal is NOT to create generic aquaponics content.

The goal is to create a premium product-aware Instagram content plan where:
- some posts focus on Aquafoundry products
- some posts focus on fresh produce outcomes
- some posts focus on aquaponics systems
- some posts focus on Indian urban lifestyle
- some posts are educational
- some posts are sustainability-focused
- some posts are mascot-supported storytelling posts

--------------------------------------------------
CONTEXT & HOLIDAYS
--------------------------------------------------

Include relevant content for these dates/events if relevant:
{{ $node["Summarize"].json["concatenated_summary"] || 'None' }}

--------------------------------------------------
BRAND CONTEXT
--------------------------------------------------

Brand Name:
Aquafoundry

Website:
https://www.aquafoundry.com/

Location:
India

Niche:
Aquaponics, sustainable farming, home-grown produce, urban farming systems, premium home-growing products

Tone:
clean, modern, eco-friendly, trustworthy, premium

Target Audience:
- urban Indian consumers
- home growers
- families
- sustainability-focused audience
- premium lifestyle audience
- people interested in clean eating
- people interested in growing food at home

Core Message:
Fresh, chemical-free produce grown using innovative aquaponics systems and premium home-growing products.

--------------------------------------------------
ASSET CATALOG
--------------------------------------------------

{{ JSON.stringify($json.Asset_Catalog) }}

--------------------------------------------------
VERY IMPORTANT PRODUCT DESCRIPTION RULE
--------------------------------------------------

The Asset_Catalog.products list contains analyzed product descriptions.

When selecting a product reference, use these fields:
- visual_description
- best_for
- prompt_guidance

For every product-focused Post:
- the ai_image_prompt must describe the selected product visually
- the selected product/product concept must be the main subject
- the ai_image_prompt must include the exact phrase: "product hero composition"
- do not create a generic aquaponics system unless the selected product description supports it
- do not create only loose greens unless ad_focus is produce-focused

Each product-focused ai_image_prompt must include:
- product visual form
- product placement
- Indian environment
- camera angle
- lighting
- negative space
- premium commercial photography style

--------------------------------------------------
PRODUCT STRATEGY CONTEXT
--------------------------------------------------

{{ $json.Product_Strategy_Context }}

Use the product references to decide WHAT each ad is about.

Very important:
- Do NOT create only generic aquaponics system ads.
- Do NOT create only generic leafy produce ads.
- Product references must actively influence the content plan.
- Product-focused posts must make the selected product or product concept the visual hero.
- Produce-focused posts must show produce as the outcome/benefit of using the product/system.
- Lifestyle-focused posts must show the product/product concept in Indian homes, balconies, terraces, or kitchens.
- Educational-focused posts must visually explain the value of the product/system.
- Sustainability-focused posts must show the eco-friendly/water-saving/circular farming benefit.
- Mascot-focused posts should use mascot storytelling but must still connect to product, produce, or brand benefit.

For every Post, select ONE product reference from Asset_Catalog.products.

The selected product reference must influence:
- product_focus
- composition_direction
- ai_image_prompt
- ad_copy
- caption

--------------------------------------------------
DESIGN STRATEGY CONTEXT
--------------------------------------------------

{{ $json.Design_Strategy_Context }}

The design references represent the desired visual language.

Use the design references to decide HOW each ad should feel visually.

Very important:
- Do NOT copy the design references exactly.
- Use them as style direction.
- Every Post must choose ONE design reference style.
- The selected design reference must influence the image prompt.
- The final ad typography will later follow this selected design style.

The selected design reference should guide:
- visual hierarchy
- negative space
- product placement
- premium ad feel
- composition direction
- typography mood
- Instagram paid-ad style

--------------------------------------------------
LOGO / MASCOT RULE
--------------------------------------------------

{{ $json.Logo_Mascot_Selection_Context }}

Do NOT select logo during strategy generation.
Do NOT select mascot during strategy generation.

Logo and mascot will be selected later after the raw image is generated.

During this strategy stage, only provide:
- mascot_action

Do not provide:
- selected_logo_url
- selected_mascot_url

--------------------------------------------------
VERY IMPORTANT STRATEGY RULE
--------------------------------------------------

For every Post:
- choose one product reference from Asset_Catalog.products
- choose one design reference style from Asset_Catalog.design_references
- create the ai_image_prompt based on the selected product and selected design style
- do not create generic aquaponics-only prompts unless ad_focus is system-focused
- do not make loose greens the hero unless ad_focus is produce-focused
- make at least 50% of Posts product-focused
- every product-focused Post must clearly describe a product hero ad

--------------------------------------------------
AD FOCUS ROTATION
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include one:

"ad_focus"

Choose from:
- product-focused
- produce-focused
- system-focused
- lifestyle-focused
- educational-focused
- sustainability-focused
- mascot-focused

Rules:
- Do not repeat the same ad_focus consecutively.
- At least 50% of Posts must be product-focused.
- Product-focused posts must make the selected product/product concept the hero.
- Produce-focused posts must show produce as the benefit or outcome.
- System-focused posts can show the aquaponics system.
- Lifestyle-focused posts should show the product/system in Indian home, balcony, kitchen, or terrace context.
- Educational-focused posts should visually explain the product/system benefit.
- Sustainability-focused posts should show eco-friendly, water-saving, circular farming mood.
- Mascot-focused posts should support storytelling, not feel childish.

--------------------------------------------------
PRODUCT-FOCUSED POST RULE
--------------------------------------------------

For every product-focused Post:

The selected product contains important product truth metadata:

- product_visual_identity
- product_color_direction
- packaging_photography_style
- product_priority_type

The ai_image_prompt MUST use these fields.

--------------------------------------------------
VERY IMPORTANT PRODUCT RULES
--------------------------------------------------

The generated product must visually match the selected product category exactly.

Examples:

- pesto = thick creamy herb pesto spread
- tomato sauce = warm rustic tomato sauce
- salad = fresh leafy produce
- dressing = liquid dressing consistency

Never visually confuse:
- pesto with juice
- sauce with smoothie
- salad with sauce
- dressing with pesto

The ai_image_prompt must:
- use product_visual_identity
- use product_color_direction
- use packaging_photography_style
- respect forbidden_visuals

Do NOT create generic green wellness drinks unless the product is actually a juice product.

Do NOT create aquaponics systems for packaged_food unless explicitly system-focused.

Product category consistency is mandatory.

--------------------------------------------------
PRODUCT SELECTION
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:
- selected_product_reference_id
- selected_product_reference_url
- product_focus

Product focus examples:
- compact balcony aquaponics system
- home grow kit
- fresh herb growing product
- premium urban farming product
- aquaponics produce basket
- smart home farming setup
- leafy greens harvest kit
- kitchen-to-balcony farming setup
- product-led fresh food solution
- product that helps Indian homes grow clean food

The product_focus should be specific and should match the selected product reference.

--------------------------------------------------
DESIGN SELECTION
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:
- selected_design_reference_id
- design_reference_style

The selected design reference should influence:
- composition_direction
- negative space
- product placement
- premium ad feel
- typography mood for final edit
- clean Instagram ad structure

Do not copy the design reference exactly.
Use it as creative direction.

--------------------------------------------------
COMPOSITION DIRECTION
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:

"composition_direction"

Examples:
- premium product hero shot with soft Indian balcony background
- cinematic product close-up with negative space on the left
- product displayed beside fresh greens in Indian terrace light
- editorial kitchen scene with product and herbs
- clean product-first commercial composition
- lifestyle scene with family harvesting from home system
- wide terrace farming scene with clean wall space for text
- product demonstration scene with realistic Indian hands
- product centered on a clean table with Indian home balcony depth
- product placed near fresh harvest basket with premium natural light

Rules:
- Do not use fixed templates.
- Do not use layout A/B/C/D.
- Make each composition visually unique.
- Composition must support ad_focus and product_focus.
- Composition must leave clean negative space for typography.

--------------------------------------------------
INDIA-SPECIFIC VISUAL RULES
--------------------------------------------------

All visuals must reflect Indian context.

Use:
- Indian balconies
- Indian terraces
- Indian kitchens
- Indian homes
- small urban farming setups
- Indian hands and skin tones
- natural Indian daylight
- realistic Indian apartments/buildings

DO NOT:
- create Western homes
- create unrealistic farms
- create fantasy environments
- create generic foreign greenhouse scenes
- create overly futuristic sci-fi setups

--------------------------------------------------
IMAGE PROMPT RULES
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:

"ai_image_prompt"

The image prompt must be product-aware and design-aware.

The prompt should describe:
- selected product reference influence
- selected product visual_description
- selected product prompt_guidance
- product/environment placement
- Indian context
- lighting
- camera angle
- composition
- mood
- focal subject
- negative space for typography
- premium commercial photography direction
- how the selected design reference style influences composition

DO NOT include:
- actual text
- logo
- mascot
- CTA
- typography instructions
- headline placement
- button placement

The raw image should already feel like a professional advertising scene before final edit.

--------------------------------------------------
GOOD IMAGE PROMPT EXAMPLES
--------------------------------------------------

For product-focused:
"Premium product hero composition of the selected Aquafoundry home-growing product in a modern Indian balcony, product clearly centered and desirable, fresh herbs around it as supporting elements, soft natural daylight, clean negative space on the right, modern DTC commercial photography, premium green-white-blue mood, realistic Indian apartment background, no text, no logo, no mascot."

For produce-focused:
"Close-up commercial photography of fresh herbs and leafy greens harvested from an Aquafoundry product setup, Indian hands holding the produce near a clean balcony farming system, produce as the benefit/outcome, soft morning light, premium natural colors, clean negative space for later typography, realistic Indian home context, no text, no logo, no mascot."

For lifestyle-focused:
"Premium lifestyle scene of an Indian family using an Aquafoundry home-growing product on a terrace, product visible and naturally integrated, fresh greens nearby, warm daylight, clean modern composition inspired by premium Instagram ad design, negative space for text, no logo, no mascot, no typography."

For educational-focused:
"Clean product demonstration scene showing the selected Aquafoundry product/system in an Indian balcony, visible water/plant/fish relationship suggested naturally, product clear and central, minimal uncluttered composition, premium commercial photography, clean space for educational overlay later, no text, no logo, no mascot."

--------------------------------------------------
CREATIVE DIRECTION
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:

"creative_direction"

Rotate between:
- editorial premium
- cinematic lifestyle
- modern DTC
- organic luxury
- energetic commercial
- documentary realism

--------------------------------------------------
MARKETING ANGLE
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:

"marketing_angle"

Rotate:
- Offer
- Benefit
- Freshness
- Sustainability
- Education
- Trust
- Urgency

--------------------------------------------------
MASCOT ACTION
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:

"mascot_action"

Rotate between:
- pointing
- holding produce
- explaining
- interacting with plants
- presenting product
- harvesting
- celebrating freshness

Do not choose the actual mascot image.
Only describe the intended mascot action for later.

--------------------------------------------------
PRODUCT RENDERING MODE RULE
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post must include:

"product_type"
"rendering_mode"
"selected_product_label_url"
"product_label_rule"
"serving_format"
"forbidden_visuals"

Rules:

If product_type is salad or fresh produce:
- rendering_mode must be "creative_food_scene"
- selected_product_label_url may be empty
- do not force packaging
- salads may be shown as bowls, plates, harvest scenes, flatlays, or lifestyle food photography

If product_type is pesto, dressing, sauce, jar, bottle, or packaged product:
- rendering_mode must be "packaging_locked"
- selected_product_label_url must use the selected product's label_url
- raw image prompt must create a realistic jar/bottle/packaging scene with blank label area
- do not generate fake product label text
- do not invent product names
- do not recreate the label
- the exact uploaded label will be applied later in final edit

Always respect:
- label_rule
- serving_format
- forbidden_visuals

--------------------------------------------------
AD COPY RULES
--------------------------------------------------

Each Post MUST include:

"ad_copy": {
  "headline": "3-6 words",
  "cta": "2-3 words",
  "features": [
    "...",
    "...",
    "..."
  ]
}

Rules:
- headline = strong hook
- CTA = short and premium
- features = short, benefit-focused
- copy should match ad_focus and product_focus
- product-focused posts should have product-led copy
- produce-focused posts should have freshness/health copy
- sustainability-focused posts should have eco/water-saving copy

DO NOT generate ad_copy for Reels.

--------------------------------------------------
REELS
--------------------------------------------------

Each Reel must include:
- 20–30 sec script
- scene-by-scene
- camera movement
- hook
- emotional pacing

Reels do not need:
- ad_copy
- selected_product_reference_url
- selected_design_reference_id

--------------------------------------------------
CAPTION RULES
--------------------------------------------------

Captions must:
- be engaging
- feel human-written
- contain 3+ sentences
- contain 5–8 hashtags
- avoid generic AI tone
- match the selected ad_focus
- mention product benefits naturally where relevant

--------------------------------------------------
STRICT CONTENT RULES
--------------------------------------------------

1. EXACTLY 2 items per day:
- 1 Post
- 1 Reel

2. NO carousels

3. DAY FORMAT:
"Day [X]: [Date] - [Topic Title]"

4. Return ONLY valid JSON array.

5. Do not add explanation outside JSON.

--------------------------------------------------
OUTPUT FORMAT
--------------------------------------------------

Return ONLY valid JSON array.

[
  {
    "day": "Day 1: ...",
    "posts": [
{
  "post_type": "Post",
  "creative_direction": "...",
  "ad_focus": "...",

  "selected_product_reference_id": "product1",

  "ad_copy": {
    "headline": "...",

    "product_visual_identity": "...",

  },
  "caption": "..."
}

This is NOT the final ad.
This image will later receive typography, logo, mascot, and sometimes an exact product label.

--------------------------------------------------
CAMPAIGN CONTEXT
--------------------------------------------------

Ad Focus:
{{ $json.Ad_Focus }}

Product Focus:
{{ $json.Product_Focus }}

Product Type:
{{ $json.Product_Type }}

Rendering Mode:
{{ $json.Rendering_Mode }}

Serving Format:
{{ $json.Serving_Format }}

Forbidden Visuals:
{{ $json.Forbidden_Visuals }}

Product Label Rule:
{{ $json.Product_Label_Rule }}

Selected Design Reference:
{{ $json.Selected_Design_Reference_ID }}

Design Reference Style:
{{ $json.Design_Reference_Style }}

Composition Direction:
{{ $json.Composition_Direction }}

Creative Direction:
{{ $json.Creative_Direction }}

--------------------------------------------------
STRICT PRODUCT VISUAL TRUTH
--------------------------------------------------

Product Visual Identity:
{{ $json.Product_Visual_Identity }}

Product Color Direction:
{{ $json.Product_Color_Direction }}

Packaging Photography Style:
{{ $json.Packaging_Photography_Style }}

Product Priority Type:
{{ $json.Product_Priority_Type }}

The image MUST visually follow Product Visual Identity exactly.

Use Product Color Direction exactly:
{{ $json.Product_Color_Direction }}

Use Packaging Photography Style exactly:
{{ $json.Packaging_Photography_Style }}

Do not guess the product appearance.
Do not reinterpret the product category.

--------------------------------------------------
RENDERING MODE RULES
--------------------------------------------------

If Rendering_Mode is creative_food_scene:
- create a natural food/product scene
- do not force packaging
- salads may be shown as bowls, plates, harvest scenes, flatlays, or lifestyle food photography
- fresh produce may be shown naturally
- keep the scene appetizing, premium, and realistic

If Rendering_Mode is packaging_locked:
- create a realistic packaged product scene
- use the specified Serving Format
- create a jar, bottle, pouch, or package as needed
- create a clean blank label area on the product
- leave space for the exact uploaded product label to be applied later
- do NOT generate label text
- do NOT generate fake product names
- do NOT generate fake packaging typography
- do NOT create salad bowl as hero if forbidden

--------------------------------------------------
STRICT PRODUCT CATEGORY LOCK
--------------------------------------------------

The generated product MUST visually match Product Type exactly.

Allowed mappings:

- sauce → thick tomato/herb sauce in sauce jar only
- pesto → thick green pesto spread in pesto jar only
- salad → salad bowl, plate, or fresh produce scene only
- dressing → dressing bottle only
- juice → beverage bottle only

Never visually transform:
- sauce into juice
- pesto into smoothie
- pesto into drink
- salad into sauce
- dressing into pesto
- jar product into beverage bottle

If Product_Type is:
- sauce → use red/orange tomato-based tones
- pesto → use thick green pesto texture
- salad → use fresh leafy produce
- dressing → use liquid dressing consistency

The image must visually communicate the correct food category immediately.

Respect Forbidden Visuals:
{{ $json.Forbidden_Visuals }}

--------------------------------------------------
AQUAPONICS VISUAL CONTROL
--------------------------------------------------

Do NOT force aquaponics systems into every image.

If Product Priority Type is packaged_food:
- focus on premium packaged food advertising
- aquaponics should be implied through freshness, ingredients, and clean food quality
- do not show pipes, tanks, grow beds, or hydroponic trays unless Ad Focus is system-focused

If Ad Focus is system-focused:
- show the aquaponics/home-growing system clearly and beautifully

--------------------------------------------------
RAW IMAGE STYLE
--------------------------------------------------

Create:
- realistic premium commercial photography
- Indian context
- natural Indian daylight
- clean negative space
- strong focal point
- high-end Instagram ad background
- product/design-aware composition
- food/product advertising quality
- correct product color and texture
- uncluttered composition

--------------------------------------------------
STRICT NEGATIVE RULES
--------------------------------------------------

No text.
No words.
No letters.
No logo.
No mascot.
No CTA.
No readable product labels.
No fake packaging text.
No posters.
No banners.
No UI.
No typography.
No wrong product category.
No beverage bottle unless Product_Type is juice.
No green juice unless Product_Type is juice.
No salad bowl as hero for sauce/pesto.

parameters.jsCode:
const base = "https://YOUR_PROJECT.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/aquaponics-media/assets";

const productRows = $input.all().map(item => item.json);

const products = productRows
  .filter(row => {
    return String(row.Asset_Type || "").toLowerCase() === "product" &&
           String(row.Status || "").toLowerCase() === "active";
  })
  .map(row => ({
    id: row.Asset_ID,
    url: row.Asset_URL,
    name: row.Product_Category || row.Asset_ID,

    product_type: row.Product_Type || "",
    rendering_mode: row.Rendering_Mode || "creative_food_scene",
    label_url: row.Label_URL || "",
    label_rule: row.Label_Rule || "",
    serving_format: row.Serving_Format || "",
    forbidden_visuals: row.Forbidden_Visuals || "",

    product_visual_identity: row.Product_Visual_Identity || "",
    product_color_direction: row.Product_Color_Direction || "",
    packaging_photography_style: row.Packaging_Photography_Style || "",
    product_priority_type: row.Product_Priority_Type || "",

    visual_description: row.Visual_Description || "",
    best_for: row.Best_For || "",
    prompt_guidance: row.Prompt_Guidance || ""
  }));

if (!products.length) {
  throw new Error("No active product assets found in Asset_Catalog sheet");
}

return {
  Asset_Catalog: {
    products,

    design_references: [
      {
        id: "design",
        url: `${base}/designs/design.png`,
        style_name: "Bold food product poster",
        style_guidance: "Large bold hero headline, expressive accent script for one phrase, product-first food photography, clean logo placement, feature/review cards, sticker-style CTA, energetic premium Instagram food/product ad feel."
      },
      {
        id: "design1",
        url: `${base}/designs/design1.png`,
        style_name: "Split color-block fresh food ad",
        style_guidance: "Strong color blocking, bold playful display typography, fresh produce framing, large central product/food visual, expressive headline composition, high-energy social media ad style."
      },
      {
        id: "design2",
        url: `${base}/designs/design2.png`,
        style_name: "Editorial chalkboard information card",
        style_guidance: "Dark editorial background, structured info sections, ingredient/product education layout, hand-drawn accent typography, clean section dividers, premium educational food/product post style."
      }
    ],

    logos: [
      {
        id: "logo1",
        url: `${base}/logos/logo1.png`,
        usage: "best for light and clean backgrounds"
      },
      {
        id: "logo2",
        url: `${base}/logos/logo2.png`,
        usage: "best for darker or image-heavy backgrounds"
      }
    ],

    mascots: [
      {
        id: "mascot1",
        url: `${base}/mascots/mascot1.png`,
        action: "friendly brand presence"
      },
      {
        id: "mascot2",
        url: `${base}/mascots/mascot2.png`,
        action: "product interaction or explanation"
      },
      {
        id: "mascot3",
        url: `${base}/mascots/mascot3.png`,
        action: "freshness, harvest, lifestyle, energetic CTA"
      }
    ]
  },

  Product_Strategy_Context: `
The product catalog contains analyzed visual descriptions and product rendering rules.

There are two rendering modes:

1. creative_food_scene
Use for salads, fresh produce, harvest scenes, plated food, bowls, and produce-forward ads.
These do NOT require label compositing.
Do not force packaging for these products.

2. packaging_locked
Use for pesto, dressing, sauces, jars, bottles, and packaged products.
These MUST use the provided exact product label later in final edit.
The raw image should create blank packaging or a clean label placement area.
Do not generate fake label text.

For every product, use:
- product_type
- rendering_mode
- label_url
- label_rule
- serving_format
- forbidden_visuals
- visual_description
- best_for
- prompt_guidance

For product-focused posts:
- use the selected product's visual_description
- use the selected product's prompt_guidance
- respect rendering_mode
- respect forbidden_visuals
- do not default to generic aquaponics systems
- do not default to loose greens only
`,

  Design_Strategy_Context: `
Use the design references to guide premium Instagram ad style:
- expressive food/product typography
- clean spacing
- strong hierarchy
- product-first layout
- modern DTC ad feel
- premium green/blue/white mood
- professional paid-ad style
- feature chips/cards

`,

Do not select logo or mascot during strategy generation.
Logo and mascot will be selected later after the raw image is generated.
`

Analyze:
1. The generated raw image.
2. The campaign details.
3. The available logo and mascot catalog.

--------------------------------------------------
CAMPAIGN
--------------------------------------------------

Headline:
{{ $json.Headline }}

Subheadline:
{{ $json.Subheadline }}

CTA:
{{ $json.CTA }}

{{ JSON.stringify($json.Asset_Catalog) }}

- choose only one mascot
- choose based on lighting, negative space, composition, product focus, and storytelling fit

Return ONLY valid JSON:

{

=You are a senior product advertising strategist for Aquafoundry.

Analyze the uploaded product/reference image.

Your job is to convert this image into a clear text description that can later help another AI model create product-centered Instagram ads.

Do NOT describe it vaguely.

Focus on:
- what product or product group is visible
- shape and structure
- colors
- materials
- packaging or layout
- produce/greens/herbs visible
- aquaponics/home-growing elements
- how this product could appear in a premium ad
- what ad types this reference is best for

Return ONLY valid JSON:

{
  "visual_description": "Detailed visual description of the product/reference image in 2-4 sentences.",
  "product_category": "Short category name, e.g. compact balcony aquaponics system, leafy greens product, herb grow kit, product menu, produce basket, etc.",
  "best_for": "Best ad use cases, e.g. product hero ads, lifestyle ads, educational ads, freshness ads, offer ads.",
  "prompt_guidance": "Clear guidance for future image prompts. Explain how to use this product/reference in raw image generation without creating generic aquaponics-only visuals."
}

parameters.prompt:
=Transform this raw Aquafoundry image into a premium Instagram ad creative.

Use only:
- uploaded raw image
- uploaded logo
- uploaded mascot

Do NOT add product/design reference images here.
The product and design direction is already baked into the raw image and campaign context.

--------------------------------------------------
PRIMARY ROLE
--------------------------------------------------

You are acting as:
- a premium ad compositor
- a modern DTC food-brand designer
- a commercial typography art director

Your job is to:
- preserve the raw image
- preserve the uploaded logo identity
- preserve the uploaded mascot identity
- create premium expressive typography
- add headline, features, and CTA
- create a polished Instagram ad

Your job is NOT to:
- redesign the mascot
- redesign the logo
- invent new brand assets
- recreate the product
- change the product concept
- create a new mascot character
- create a new logo treatment
- force product labels or packaging

--------------------------------------------------
ASSET PRESERVATION RULES
--------------------------------------------------

The uploaded logo and uploaded mascot are exact brand assets.

Do NOT:
- redesign them
- redraw them
- change mascot character identity
- create a new mascot
- change mascot face, body, cap, colors, clothing, or style
- generate a different vegetable character
